logp.method_description: Lipophilicity was measured in n-octanol/buffer by shaking-flask method. Phosphate buffer (10 mM, pH 7.4) was presaturated with the complex at different concentrations. The same volume (2.0 mL) of complex solution and n-octyl alcohol were mixed and placed in an air-bath orbital oscillator overnight at a constant temperature (25.0 ± 0.1 °C) and a rotation speed of 200 RPM. After centrifugation at 2500 RPM for 15 min, the samples were divided into two phases. The concentration of solute in the aqueous phase was determined by spectrophotometry (λmax = 319 nm). According to the law of mass conservation, the lipo-hydrogen distribution coefficient Po/w (Po/w = Co/Cw = Ao/Aw, A stands for absorbance) of the n-octanol phase was calculated.
